text:
Harper Lee: quick UX QA: the elevated primary in the small inline actions looks heavier than the modal primary. on dark bg it reads as a floating chip instead of a button. also the press ripple is different. noticed during a console pass.

Diego M.: good catch. sounds like elevation tokens diverged. table-actions use `--rwd-elev-2` while modal uses `--rwd-elev-1` (we changed the system last cycle).

Ruth Kim: also the toast uses a soft shadow that visually sits above row actions and briefly obscures focus when it appears. on 375px width it covers the chevron area.

Harper Lee: repro: Console > Deployments > hover row > inline Confirm button vs open Delete modal > Confirm (primary). toggle a toast by saving. Compare shadows + press states.

Diego M.: snippet from storybook:```css
.button { box-shadow: var(--rwd-elev-1); }
.table .row-action .button { box-shadow: var(--rwd-elev-2); }
.toast { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); bottom: 16px; left: 16px; }
```

Ruth Kim: proposal:
- introduce `--rwd-elevation-button` and set both modal+inline to it (keeps consistent perceived weight)
- create `--rwd-toast-safety-margin` for components to consume so inline menus can add bottom padding when toast present
- standardize press/ripple timing to 180ms across components

Harper Lee: accessibility notes: if we change elevation and padding, ensure hit target >=44px and focus ring still has >=4.5:1 contrast on all themes.

Diego M.: agreed. I'll add a migration note in tokens.md and update the button spec to declare `--rwd-button-focus` and `--rwd-button-press-duration`.

QA-Bot: Visual snapshot job queued for branch `ux/button-elev-toast-gap` (jobs: visual-regression, a11y-run).

Ruth Kim: copy nit: inline label currently says "Confirm" while modal shows "Confirm changes". suggestion: keep inline short, modal full sentence. adding to component docs guidance.

Harper Lee: tiny polish: reduce inline button border-radius by 2px so it reads more compact next to icons. add it as optional `--rwd-button-radius-compact`.

Diego M.: will change CSS to use tokens and remove hard-coded px. sample after change:```css
.button { box-shadow: var(--rwd-elevation-button); padding: var(--rwd-space-2) var(--rwd-space-3); border-radius: var(--rwd-button-radius); transition: box-shadow 180ms; }
.table .row-action { padding-bottom: calc(var(--rwd-toast-safety-margin, 0px)); }
.toast { bottom: var(--rwd-toast-offset, 16px); transition: transform 200ms ease; }
```

Harper Lee: can we also add a combined story (table + modal + toast) so visual-regression captures the interaction?

Diego M.: yes. I'll add stories: buttons/consistency, table/inline-with-toast, toast/safety-gap.

DesignBot: PR #4482 created for `ux/button-elev-toast-gap`  checks: visual-regression, a11y-lint. Preview: https://deploy.preview/r/4482

Ruth Kim: I'll run the a11y checklist once preview is up. special check: focus ring color on dark theme.

QA-Bot: Preview build passed visual-regression for button tokens, flagged 1 a11y advisory (focus contrast on dark primary) assigned to Ruth.

Diego M.: fixing focus color now to `--rwd-focus-strong` across themes and will push small update.

DesignBot: PR #4482 merged to staging. Changed stories: buttons/consistency, table/inline-with-toast, toast/safety-gap. CI: visual-regression OK, a11y advisory cleared after patch.
